# KataGo Remote One-Click v0.1.4

Fixes browser-client connectivity and an analysis-query bug that left LizzieYzy Next without candidate moves.

## Fixes

- **Warnings no longer end analysis queries**: a KataGo warning such as `Unexpected or unused field` was treated as a final result, which removed the query route and dropped every later result. LizzieYzy Next then showed no candidate moves and the next analysis failed with `another websocket analysis query is still active`. Warnings are now forwarded without completing the query.
- **Legacy `playoutDoublingAdvantage`**: values sent at the top level (as LizzieYzy Next does) are moved into `overrideSettings`, so the setting takes effect and KataGo no longer emits the warning.
- **Cross-origin WebSocket clients**: the bridge now accepts any `Origin`, so browser clients hosted on another domain (for example a GitHub Pages build of web-katrain) can connect. The private path token remains the only credential.

## Upgrade

```bash
curl -fsSLo /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ykrsama/katago-remote-one-click/v0.1.4/install.sh
bash /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh
```

Existing KataGo files, fixed-hostname settings, private links, and the Human SL model are reused.
